title: knowgov pending questions report
description: What `python harness/questions.py pending HANDLE` prints and the MCP tool pending_questions returns (task-0361, decision-0046 point 2): an issued handle's open questions, read from the questionnaires the instance keeps in the folder its questions.toml names, across every subject the reader serves, less the items a capture in the subject's capture folder answered on or after the questionnaire's generated_on (from the questionnaire's owner unit; a review-due one, from the handle it is addressed to). Items and answered sorted by subject, scenario, key and questionnaire; skipped by file. Files only, never the store. Version 1; a change is additive or a new version. Exit 2 prints no report.

unit.description: the handle's unit, as the register's issued list holds it

on.description: the date the handle was read as issued and not withdrawn on, YYYY-MM-DD

questions.description: the questions folder read, relative to the instance

route.description: owner: a questionnaire for the handle's unit; review-due: one addressed to the handle or its unit

questionnaire.description: the questionnaire's file, relative to the instance

level.description: the gate's level when the questionnaire was generated

closed_by.description: the unit that closes the key's declared gap, as the questionnaire names it

evidence.description: whether the instance holds the item's evidence (question_evidence)

capture.description: the statement id the load gives the answer or the nobody-knows
